newsitem.title: CANADA: Falconbridge signs Zambia copper deal.
newsitem.headline: Falconbridge signs Zambia copper deal.

text.p: Falconbridge Ltd said on Tuesday that a consortium it belongs to has signed a memorandum of understanding with the government of Zambia and Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines Ltd.

The deal gives the consortium with exclusive rights to conduct a feasibility study on the Konkola project, which consists of the Konkola Mine and concentrator, as well as the Mufulira smelter and refinery.
Falconbridge is in a consortium with Gencor Ltd and Zambia Copper Investments Ltd, an associate of Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd.
The Konkola Deep Mining Project has an ore resource of 340 million tonnes at 3.8 percent copper and should sustain mining operations for more than 30 years, Falconbridge said.
The company expects the project will produce approximately 180,000 tonnes of finished copper annually, with estimated capital costs between US$700-US$800 million.

The consortium also said it would be willing to take a majority stake in a company called KonkCo, which would include the Konkola project and the Mufulira smelter and refinery. The commitment to assume the majority stake would be made in the second half of 1997, before a final decision is made on the Konkola project, Falconbridge said.
The consortium expects to finish the feasibility study by the end of the year.
